name: joins and aggregates multiple order lines
test:
orders=[{'order_id':1,'product_id':101,'quantity':2,'unit_price':10.0,'status':'completed'},{'order_id':2,'product_id':102,'quantity':1,'unit_price':20.0,'status':'pending'},{'order_id':3,'product_id':103,'quantity':3,'unit_price':5.0,'status':'completed'},{'order_id':4,'product_id':101,'quantity':1,'unit_price':10.0,'status':'cancelled'}]
products=[{'product_id':101,'category_id':1},{'product_id':102,'category_id':2},{'product_id':103,'category_id':1}]
categories=[{'category_id':1,'category_name':'Fast Food'},{'category_id':2,'category_name':'Drinks'}]
actual=solution(orders,products,categories)
assert actual[0]=={'category_name':'Drinks','total_sales':20.0,'average_sales_per_order':20.0,'completion_rate':0.0}
assert actual[1]['category_name']=='Fast Food' and actual[1]['total_sales']==45.0 and actual[1]['average_sales_per_order']==15.0
assert abs(actual[1]['completion_rate']-2/3)<1e-12

input: one matched and two unmatched orders
